lead: A test that asserts memory was released fails on the scheduler, because `nvs_host::Scheduler` keeps every finished task's whole `Ctx`.
body: `CoroutineResult::Return` pushes a `Finished { id, ctx, outcome }` onto `self.finished` and only `take_finished` removes one, so a context outlives its join and `live_bytes` sees no drop. Read after `run_until_idle` returns, where the `Scheduler` is dropped, or drain the list first.
